In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Durant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] deployed his '''battalion''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to [[Invasion of Taris|fight]] the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] used the battalion's movements to locate and [[Destruction of the War Trust|assassinate]] Durant.<ref name="Table" />
